cell.description: Minecraft [x, y, z] cell. Y points up, +X east, +Z south.

vector.description: [x, y, z] in viewport world units.

discard.description: Allow replacing the scene if it contains unsaved edits.

size.description: Width, height and depth in blocks.

tools.name: get_scene
tools.description: Read the current project name, file path and format, whether it has unsaved edits, the Minecraft Java release if known, DataVersion, bounds, block and selection counts, camera, and globally installed resource packs.

tools.name: new_project
tools.description: Start a new empty project in the editor. Returns its name, the Minecraft Java release if known, DataVersion and block count.

minecraft_version.description: Minecraft Java release, e.g. 1.21.1 or 26.3. Takes precedence over data_version. Defaults to the current project if neither is supplied.

data_version.description: Legacy numeric Minecraft Java DataVersion. Prefer minecraft_version.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open a Java .nbt structure, .litematic schematic or Bedrock .mcstructure file as the active project without showing a file picker. Returns the file path, format, Java export version and DataVersion, and block count.

path.description: Absolute file path on the machine running Builder MCP.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Save the active project as .nbt, .litematic or Bedrock .mcstructure without showing a file picker. With no path, update the active file when its format matches, or create a file in the app's exports directory. Returns the saved path, format, byte size and block count.

path.description: Absolute destination path on the machine running Builder MCP. Its extension selects the default format.

format.description: Defaults to the path's format, then the active format, then litematic.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing destination. Defaults to true when saving back to the active file with no path, and false for an explicit path.

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.description: Read placed blocks and their states, optionally inside an inclusive box. Results are ordered by Y, Z, X and paginated.

tools.name: search_palette
tools.description: Search the loaded block catalog by display name or resource ID, optionally limited to one mod ID. Returns default states and allowed property values.

mod_id.description: Exact block namespace, such as minecraft or create.

tools.name: set_blocks
tools.description: Set individual cells in one undoable operation. An existing cell may be replaced. Use a null state or minecraft:air to remove a cell.

tools.name: fill_box
tools.description: Fill an inclusive box with a block state. If hollow is true, fill the shell and clear the interior. Undo restores all affected cells.

tools.name: remove_box
tools.description: Remove blocks inside an inclusive box. This operation can be undone.

tools.name: select_box
tools.description: Select all existing blocks inside an inclusive box in the editor.

tools.name: copy_selection
tools.description: Copy the currently selected blocks to the editor's clipboard. Returns the number of copied blocks and the bounding box dimensions [width, height, depth].

tools.name: paste_selection
tools.description: Paste the clipboard with its minimum corner at origin and select the pasted blocks. Copied blocks replace any blocks at their destination cells. Empty cells in the copy leave the destination intact. Undo reverts a paste in one step.

tools.name: transform_selection
tools.description: Move, rotate about the Y axis clockwise as viewed from above, and resize the current selection. Rotation precedes resizing. The minimum corner stays fixed unless origin is specified. Cells outside the selection are preserved.

tools.name: undo_redo
tools.description: Undo or redo the last project edit, including edits made in the editor.

tools.name: set_camera
tools.description: Switch projection or set a camera pose. The isometric preset uses orthographic projection by default. Returns the camera position, target, projection and its field of view or orthographic height.

projection.description: Switch projection while retaining the direction and apparent scale at the target. Can be combined with a preset or a position and target.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Return a PNG using the current camera and viewport aspect ratio. Set transparent to render the building alone on a transparent background.

width.description: Maximum screenshot width or transparent render longest edge. Defaults to 1440.

tools.name: render_block_states
tools.description: Preview placed block models using the active resource packs. Returns one 256×256 PNG with a transparent background per state in input order. Missing block models or textures use a purple and black checkerboard. Air returns an empty image. Uses the default isometric angle unless follow_camera is true. Each image frames its block independently.

follow_camera.description: Use the live viewport orientation and projection with the block centered in the preview.

tools.name: export_structure
tools.description: Export a copy of the current project as .nbt, .litematic or Bedrock .mcstructure with its minimum corner at [0,0,0]. Returns the local absolute path under the app's exports directory.
